data.name: Chronomaze: Gravity Maze
data.detailed_description:
YOU DO NOT CONTROL THE HERO. YOU CONTROL THE UNIVERSE.


Welcome to Chronomaze: Gravity Maze, a study in minimalist precision where the only thing you can influence is the laws of physics themselves.

In most games, you move the character. Here, the character is helpless—a particle at the mercy of momentum. Your only tool is gravity. Change its direction to navigate tight corridors, build lethal velocity, and solve intricate physics puzzles before the clock runs out.

THE EXPERIENCE

Chronomaze is not about luck; it is about flow.
  • Clinical Aesthetics: A high-contrast "Glow" visual style designed for pure clarity. No visual noise. Just the maze and the goal.
  • Curated Challenges: 8 hand-crafted levels that escalate from simple navigation to complex, reflex-heavy puzzles. Zero filler content.
  • Immersive Soundscape: A hypnotic soundtrack and responsive sound design built to keep you in the "zone."
  • Respect for Your Time: No loading screens, no ads, no bloat.Pure focus.

CONTROLS

Simple to learn. Difficult to master.
  • Arrow Keys: Shift Gravity (Up, Down, Left, Right)

DESIGN PHILOSOPHY

"The concept is simple. The execution is everything."

Chronomaze is the debut release from Gift Bytes Productions.
We built this game as a reaction against modern gaming bloat. We stripped away the microtransactions, the daily logins, and the noise to leave only what matters: A clean, honest, and challenging physics experience.

Whether you have 5 minutes or an hour, the maze is waiting.

data.short_description: Control gravity, not the player, in Chronomaze: Gravity Maze—a 2D minimalist physics puzzler. Can you navigate 8 challenging, high-speed levels to beat the clock? A stylish, free game with a hypnotic soundtrack and a high-score chase.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x64, 2.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11+ compatible graphics card
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 / Intel Iris Plus Graphics
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04
  • Processor: x64, 2.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenGL 3.3+ or Vulkan compatible
